title: Noaptea de Sanziene
description:
'Night of the Sânziene'
The work captures the poetic tension of the Night of Sânziene—the sacred moment when the forest becomes a gateway to the unseen realm.
In the heart of a midsummer night, light fades, and the vibration of nature transforms into a secret ritual.
Dark tones of violet, green, and ochre blend into a dense, almost hypnotic atmosphere, suggesting the hidden forces of the place.

The pictorial space seems to pulse as if touched by invisible presences: the Iele—spirits of the forest—subtly insinuate themselves, affecting the viewer more through sensation than form.
At the top, a white translucent silhouette—perhaps a bird, or even the spirit of the forest itself—floats as a sign of the passage between worlds.

'The Dance of the Iele' explores the fluid boundary between myth and reality, between fascination and unease.
It is an invitation to see the forest not as a landscape, but as a living, mysterious entity that calls to us, enchants us, and transforms us.
